current.text: He is a rookie recovering from another knee surgery. The early timetable was about six months, and Yahoo lists him as out (knee).
The Spurs have not ruled him out for the season. He could play at some point this season, but it is uncertain.
He sits behind Victor Wembanyama. The Spurs drafted three centers and have a very deep forward group.
Becoming a starter will take time.
After the latest knee surgery, he dropped to 27th in dynasty rookie rankings (tier six).
He is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. His projected Yahoo value is 0 USD.

durable.text: He has had repeated knee surgeries, and experts flag ongoing knee risk.
He is very young, a strong shot blocker and a big who runs the rim.
His free throw shooting is very poor.
He makes no threes and scores little. Blocks and rim finishing are where his value would come from.
If he stays healthy, he is projected to become a dominant defensive player.
